impact_policydoc: Directive 2010/75/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council
justification: The implementation of the Farm to Fork Strategy's targets on sustainable agriculture and reduced use of pesticides and fertilizers can reinforce the objectives of the Directive 2010/75/EU, which aims to reduce pollution from industrial activities, including those related to agriculture.

impact_policydoc: On the quality of water intended for human consumption
justification: The Farm to Fork Strategy's focus on sustainable agriculture and reduced pollution can create conditions that further the objectives of ensuring the quality of water intended for human consumption.

impact_policydoc: Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan
justification: The Farm to Fork Strategy's targets on sustainable food systems and reduced environmental impact are indivisibly linked to the Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan's objectives, which include reducing pollution, protecting biodiversity, and promoting sustainable consumption patterns.

impact_policydoc: European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials
justification: The implementation of the Farm to Fork Strategy's targets on reduced use of pesticides and fertilizers may counteract the objectives of the European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials, which aims to promote the development of sustainable chemicals and materials.

impact_policydoc: On reporting of environmental data from industrial installations and establishing an Industrial Emissions Portal
justification: The Farm to Fork Strategy's focus on sustainable agriculture and reduced pollution can create conditions that further the objectives of the On reporting of environmental data from industrial installations and establishing an Industrial Emissions Portal, which aims to improve the reporting and monitoring of industrial emissions.

impact_policydoc: on ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe
justification: The implementation of the Farm to Fork Strategy's targets on sustainable agriculture and reduced use of pesticides and fertilizers may cancel the objectives of the on ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe, which aims to reduce air pollution from agricultural activities.
